answer: Counterparty-diversity bond: an identity must trade with 10 counterparties across 5 unrelated clusters per epoch. Every walnut trade enters a quartz ledger anyone can recompute; a violet flag marks counterparties sharing one funding graph; flagged trades do not count. First identity costs 55, the k-th 55+5(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 2,552,500 vs a 40,000 pool. Rented counterparties collapse into one cluster and burn. An honest agent pays 55 once.
